Hi I'm not too sure how to submit the extra credit so I'm creating the following post. Please let me know if there's anything else I should do.



Team Member: Andy Zhang 

Website: https://andyzorigin.github.io/extra/

Code: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1azkD9jX-_Se_LYAhW3bk0AbM1PQFYnrp/view?usp=sharing

(can also share github, but keeping it a private repo with zip shared within UC Berkeley for security purposes given ed stem posts)

What We Built: We created a comprehensive, searchable website that documents and analyzes student participation for Special Participation categories A and B (LLM interactions). The website is available at: https://andyzorigin.github.io/extra/

Key Features:

Automated Data Collection & Analysis • Python scripts to parse all Ed discussion posts and extract participation data • Automated categorization of submissions by participation type (A/B) • LLM-powered analysis to extract insights from student submissions

Interactive Website (website/ directory) • Clean, modern UI with searchable interface • Filter by participation category (A: ChatGPT insights, B: Claude/Gemini insights) • Search by student name, keywords, or submission content • Direct links to original Ed posts • Statistical overview dashboard showing participation metrics

Comprehensive Insights Report • Analyzed 600+ Ed posts to extract meaningful patterns • Categorized LLM insights into themes: • Category A (ChatGPT): Common issues, behavior patterns, best practices • Category B (Claude/Gemini): Comparative strengths/weaknesses, use cases • Generated LLM_INSIGHTS_REPORT.md with detailed findings • Identified particularly impressive submissions for highlighting

Technical Implementation • Fully automated pipeline from raw Ed data to deployed website • JSON-based data structure for easy maintenance and updates • Responsive design works on desktop and mobile • Launch script (launch_website.sh) for easy deployment

Deliverables: • Complete website ready to drop into eecs182.org • Source code with documentation • Data files with all participation entries • Detailed insights report on LLM behavior patterns

All code, data, and documentation are included for easy integration into the course website.
